name: Malachi
tagline: The last word of the Old Testament
author: Malachi.
setting: The returned community has grown lax in worship and covenant faithfulness.
theme: God loves his people and calls them to faithful worship, with a messenger promised before the day of the Lord.

outline.label: Where is the God of justice
The book of remembrance and the day

christInBook: Malachi promises a messenger who will prepare the way (3:1) and the sun of righteousness who rises with healing (4:2). The New Testament identifies John the Baptist as the messenger and Jesus as the LORD who comes to his temple.
howToRead: Malachi is a series of questions and answers. God makes a claim, the people ask “How?” and God replies. Read it as a covenant lawsuit in dialogue form.
